description: 5-second aggregated bitFlyer FX_BTC_JPY order-book/tape features, built from raw data/ws recordings (scripts/run_board_round.py, per docs referenced in Round 17). One row per 5-second bucket.
source: derived from data/ws/*.jsonl.gz (bitFlyer public WS: lightning_ticker/_executions/_board), reconstructed and bucketed by scripts/run_board_round.py
retention: kept indefinitely once written; backtest_data/board_round_<date>/ snapshots are permanent MD5-stamped copies used for reproducibility, alongside their MD5SUMS / *_qc.txt / coverage json companions

ts.notes: bucket boundary time, not a single event time -- every other column is an aggregate over [ts, ts+5s)

mid.meaning: mid price at bucket close (or last observed mid within the bucket)

spread_pct.notes: written since 2026-10-10 (L-920: a spread is not a price-move rate, so not bp) = spread / mid x 100; a value <= 0 is a crossed book and a value > 0.5 is treated as an outlier by scripts/data_quality.py's crossed-book check

spread_bps.notes: only in series written before 2026-10-10 (L-920); spread_bps / 100 = spread_pct, and scripts/data_quality.py and scripts/judge_board_round.py read it / 100

best_bid_size.meaning: size at best bid at bucket close

best_ask_size.meaning: size at best ask at bucket close

bid_depth_0p05pct.meaning: cumulative bid size within 0.05% of mid
bid_depth_0p05pct.notes: written since 2026-10-10 (L-920); the same band as the legacy bid_depth_5bps, renamed only

ask_depth_0p05pct.meaning: cumulative ask size within 0.05% of mid
ask_depth_0p05pct.notes: written since 2026-10-10 (L-920); the same band as the legacy ask_depth_5bps, renamed only

bid_depth_5bps.meaning: cumulative bid size within 0.05% of mid (legacy name)
bid_depth_5bps.notes: only in series written before 2026-10-10; same values as bid_depth_0p05pct

ask_depth_5bps.meaning: cumulative ask size within 0.05% of mid (legacy name)
ask_depth_5bps.notes: only in series written before 2026-10-10; same values as ask_depth_0p05pct

imb_0p05pct.meaning: same imbalance ratio computed over the 0.05%-of-mid depth bands
imb_0p05pct.notes: written since 2026-10-10 (L-920); was imb_5bps, same band

imb_5bps.meaning: same imbalance ratio over the 0.05%-of-mid depth bands (legacy name)
imb_5bps.notes: only in series written before 2026-10-10; same values as imb_0p05pct

n_board_updates.meaning: count of board (order book) update messages within the bucket

n_trades.meaning: count of executions within the bucket

vol_buy.meaning: buy-taker execution volume within the bucket

vol_sell.meaning: sell-taker execution volume within the bucket

n_large.meaning: count of executions classified as large prints within the bucket
n_large.notes: large-print size threshold is defined in scripts/run_board_round.py, not in this file

vol_large.meaning: volume of large-print executions within the bucket

max_trade_size.meaning: largest single execution size within the bucket
max_trade_size.notes: `nan` when n_trades is 0 for that bucket

known_defects: buckets with zero trades legitimately have n_trades=0, vol_buy=vol_sell=0.0 and max_trade_size=nan -- do not treat nan/0 rows as missing data without checking n_board_updates too (a bucket with updates but no trades is a real quiet period, not a gap)
same maintenance-window and WS-reconnect caveats as schema/bitflyer_tape.json apply, since this is built from the same raw WS captures

coverage (which UTC days/ranges are actually represented) must be read from board_round_coverage.json alongside the series, not assumed from the file's own first/last timestamp -- the series can have internal holes
